title: Weekly Purchase-Order Invoice Variance Review
facts: The weekly review identifies unmatched or over-threshold purchase-order invoice variances before Accounts Payable posts the payment batch.
Successful completion produces a reviewed workbook, exception cases for unresolved rows, and a retained audit package.
The intended audience is Accounts Payable analysts who process North America purchase-order invoices in LedgerHub.
The procedure includes the current week's PO-backed invoice export, supplier-roster comparison, variance classification, exception cases, reviewer validation, and evidence handoff.
The procedure excludes non-PO invoices, credit memos, and historical weeks unless a Finance Reviewer reopens them.
Required access includes LedgerHub, the Procurement shared mailbox, the Finance shared drive, and Exception Queue.
Required tools include Excel desktop and Teams, and access uses SSO and MFA.
Required inputs include PO_Variance_YYYYMMDD.csv, approved_supplier_roster.xlsx, invoice PDFs in LedgerHub, and the review_log.csv template.
The trigger is every Tuesday after the Procurement analyst publishes the current export, with a revised-export rerun before the deadline.
The standard path must be completed and handed off before 16:00 ET the same day.
Variance is calculated as variance_amount = invoice_amount - po_amount.
The source export must remain unchanged; the working file is PO_Variance_YYYYMMDD_reviewed.xlsx.
Reason codes are AMOUNT, MISSING_PO, and DUPLICATE, and unmatched suppliers receive MISSING_SUPPLIER.
Pending rows receive an Exception Queue case ID and are assigned to the Finance Reviewer when the queue is available.
Validation compares row count with the original export, total variance with the LedgerHub summary, status values with Clear or Pending, case IDs, and reviewer initials/timestamp.
Evidence includes the reviewed workbook, review_log.csv, case export, invoice PDFs, variance_summary_YYYYMMDD.png, and the weekly Evidence-folder link.

purpose.statement: The weekly review identifies unmatched or over-threshold purchase-order invoice variances before Accounts Payable posts the payment batch.
purpose.successful_outcome: A reviewed workbook, exception cases for unresolved rows, and a retained audit package are produced.

audience_scope.audience: Accounts Payable analysts who process North America purchase-order invoices in LedgerHub.
excluded: historical weeks unless a Finance Reviewer reopens them

readiness_checks: The LedgerHub period is not locked.
The untouched source copy is in Finance\AP\Variance\YYYY-WW\Incoming.

roles.handoff: Sends the evidence link to the Finance Reviewer.

roles.responsibility: Publishes the PO_Variance_YYYYMMDD.csv export and corrects a missing export.
roles.handoff: Confirms a replacement export in the shared mailbox.

roles.responsibility: Checks classifications, case IDs, and validation evidence.
roles.handoff: Provides reviewer initials and timestamp in review_log.csv.

triggers_timing.trigger: Every Tuesday after the Procurement analyst publishes the current export.
triggers_timing.rerun_condition: Repeat the review if a revised export arrives before the deadline.

steps.expected_result: The untouched source export is copied into the weekly Incoming folder.

must_contain: Open LedgerHub with SSO and MFA
steps.expected_result: The analyst is in the correct North America YYYY-WW Invoice Match view.
Unmatched suppliers are marked rather than added to the roster.

must_contain: do not overwrite the original CSV
steps.expected_result: A working workbook contains the calculated variance without changing the original export.
Exception candidates are filtered, reason-coded, and supported with invoice evidence.

must_contain: above it goes to Pending review

steps.expected_result: The threshold conflict is visible and is not silently resolved by the analyst.

must_contain: create an exception case in Exception Queue
assign the case to the Finance Reviewer

decision_points.condition: Absolute total variance <= $25 and no other exception
decision_points.expected_result: Status is Clear and the row is included in review_log.csv.

decision_points.condition: Absolute total variance > $25, missing PO, duplicate invoice, or unmatched supplier
decision_points.action: Keep Pending, create an Exception Queue case, and assign Finance Reviewer.
decision_points.expected_result: Case ID appears in the working file.

validation_checks: Reviewed row count matches the original export.
The sum of variance_amount equals the LedgerHub summary.
Every status is Clear or Pending.
No required case ID is blank.
review_log.csv contains reviewer initials and a timestamp.

outputs_evidence.purpose: Reviewed workbook with reason codes and Clear/Pending statuses.
One case ID for every Pending row created successfully.
Reviewer initials, review timestamp, and outage or conflict notes.

warnings_notes.text: Never edit the original CSV or overwrite a locked-period record. Work only in a copy and retain the untouched source.
Keep negative variance signs in the workbook; a negative amount indicates the invoice is below the purchase order.

exceptions.action: Check the mailbox filter, refresh once, look for a revised attachment, save missing_export_YYYYMMDD.png, and notify the Procurement analyst in Teams.

exceptions.condition: LedgerHub or Exception Queue is unavailable.
exceptions.action: Wait 15 minutes and retry; do not change statuses offline.
Keep the affected row Pending, preserve the source row and invoice PDF, and create an Exception Queue case if available.

recovery: Resume from the last saved workbook when access returns.
Keep the source unchanged and save the latest working copy.
Record the outage or threshold conflict before continuing or escalating.
escalation: If the service is not back by 14:00 ET, escalate to the finance owner referenced in the procedure.
For a row between $25 and $30, leave it Pending and ask the Finance Reviewer to route the question to the unnamed finance owner.

missing_facts.description: The procedure repeatedly refers to a finance owner for threshold conflicts and system/export outages but does not identify the accountable person's name, team queue, or contact method.
missing_facts.question: Who is the accountable finance owner or queue for resolving threshold conflicts and LedgerHub/Exception Queue outages?

conflicts.description: The current LedgerHub decision panel and decision table use an absolute total variance threshold of $25, while the copied old desk note uses $30; the conflict is repeated in the threshold escalation path.
conflicts.question: Should the Clear threshold be absolute total variance at or below $25 or at or below $30?
